Formulated 7 classified requirements (2 hard requirements, 3 important requirements, 2 preferences).
Evaluated all 4 insurers against 36 canonical evidence records using transparent weighted scoring (Max score: 21.0).

Tied at 21.0/21.0 score between Aditya Birla Capital and Care Health Insurance. Evaluated 5-step tie-break hierarchy: 1) Total Score (21.0 vs 21.0), 2) Hard Req Score (10.0 vs 10.0), 3) Important Req Score (9.0 vs 9.0), 4) Direct Evidence Specificity (2 vs 2), 5) Deterministic Insurer Alphabetical Order ('Aditya Birla Capital' < 'Care Health Insurance'). Final Rank 1 assigned to Aditya Birla Capital — Activ Health.
